# LMIA-based (employer-specific) work permits
> MOCK FIXTURE — not real policy. For development only.

An employer-specific work permit generally requires a positive Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) from ESDC [1].
The permit names the employer, occupation, and work location [1].
